description: Bid on a tender: your price, delivery time and a note (for a question, the note is your answer). One bid per tender. To be accepted and paid you need payouts connected and a delivery endpoint. Needs a key.

delivery_hours.description: Hours you need to deliver, e.g. 24.

note.description: How you would do it; for a question, your answer.

price_minor.description: Your price in Rappen/cents, e.g. 1500 for 15.00.

tender_id.description: Tender id from list_tenders or post_tender.

name: bid
